failedGraders: judge:A mobile Notifications feature was just added under packages/app/expo/app/(tabs)/notifications/ and packages/app/expo/app/(sheets)/notification-detail/. Verify ALL of: (a) NAV-MODAL — the detail modal is the (sheets)/notification-detail route registered in app/_layout.tsx via Stack.Screen with an EXPLICIT presentation; the dismissal inside the sheet pairs with that presentation (router.back() for pageSheet/formSheet, router.dismiss() for fullScreenModal); if presentation is fullScreenModal the sheet ships an inner _layout.tsx whose Stack sets an explicit headerLeft back affordance, if pageSheet/formSheet the inner layout is absent or at most a bare <Slot />; the sheet receives AT MOST the notification id via typed params and fetches its own data with its own SDK hook inside — the subject object is never passed through a store, context, or navigation params, and no web Dialog / useDialogStore / useDrawerStore pattern was carried over; sheet presentation options (presentation, sheet*) live ONLY on the root app/_layout.tsx registration, never in the sheet's inner layout. (b) STATE-PLACEMENT — the category filter and unread-only toggle round-trip through useTypedSearchParams(schema) from @/lib/typed-route with EVERY schema field .default()-ed (a garbage deep link renders the defaults), the category field typed against the SDK NotificationCategory values; writes go through the hook's setParams (or router.setParams); there is NO useState and NO Zustand store mirroring filters, server data, mutation pending flags, or modal visibility anywhere under the two new dirs. (c) COMPOSITION/LAYOUT — app/(tabs)/notifications/index.tsx is a thin default-exported shell (layout + composition only, no SDK hook calls, no business JSX); a Section component under -components/ owns the single useListNotifications query, applies the client-side category filter, and maps the rows; row leaves receive the notification item via prop and never re-fetch it (a row owning its mark-as-read mutation is fine); every colocated file lives at -components/<Name>/index.tsx with NAMED exports only (no default export under -components/ — expo-router registers every file under app/); the notifications tab trigger is registered in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx with a localized label; the tab screen is NOT wrapped in <Protected> (the (tabs) layout already gates) while the (sheets)/notification-detail route IS (it sits outside the gated group). Inspect the new files plus app/_layout.tsx, app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx and locales/{pt,en}.json. The pre-existing dangling registrations at HEAD (the (sheets)/game-form Stack.Screen and the games tab trigger with no matching folders) are out of scope.
